evidence.label: Making Sui Quantum Ready
evidence.claim: Address aliases are live and provide a migration path that can retain an account address while authorization changes; native ML-DSA and SLH-DSA rollout remains staged.

evidence.label: Sui post-quantum scheme selection
evidence.claim: Sui selected ML-DSA-65 for native accounts and SLH-DSA for high-value vaults, using two cryptographic families.
